text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq and UNSCOM continue disarmament talks.
- A diplomatic crisis could erupt between Iran and Turkey.
- National Assembly speaker receives French parliamentary delegation.
- Iraqi parliamentary delegation returns from Damascus.
- Iraq is capable of rebuilding its oil industry.
- Korean firms keen to strike deals with Iraq.
- Iraq plans to export six million barrels per day once sanctions are removed.
- Commentary criticises peace between Arabs and Israel.
